definition: the capacity a night pays back, and where that leaves me in the morning

settled:
Sleep pays back an hour of capacity for every hour slept. Six hours slept is six capacity hours, ten hours slept is ten.

So a morning opens somewhere in level two or three. Six hours lands inside level two, ten hours lands at the top of level three.

Slow breathing through the morning carries the surplus past twelve capacity hours, which is where the recovery arithmetic runs at its target.

title: What A Night Of Sleep Deposits
